visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Comparison Points the Wrong Way
visualizerParams.problemDescription: IV should be 4 and MCMXCIV should be 1994, but the program prints 6 and a wrong number.

solution.explanation: A smaller symbol in front of a bigger one (I before V) is subtracted. The test must be next > current. Reversing it subtracts the bigger symbols that come first (the M in MCMXCIV) and adds the small ones.
